name: maps
title: Maps
description: Search places and get directions in Google Maps or Apple Maps from the panel, no key needed: Search, Directions from here, from home and from work for what you type, a route as `home > work`, your saved places as rows, and, with a Places API key, autocomplete as you type. `go:` or `maps:` at the root answers inline.
author: pal

settings.label: Open in
settings.description: Which app the rows open. Apple Maps is macOS only (a `maps://` url); Copy link always copies a web url.

settings.label: Home
settings.description: An address or place name; the Home row and the “from home” directions.

settings.label: Work
settings.description: Likewise; with both set the empty palette lists the commute both ways.

settings.label: Saved places
settings.description: One per line as `Name = address` (a line without `=` is both). Each is a row: open, directions to it, copy the address.

settings.label: Places API key
settings.description: Optional. A Google Cloud key with Places API (New) enabled: place predictions appear under the rows as you type (autocomplete requests are billed by Google past the monthly free credit). Empty: nothing is fetched, the urls need no key.

store.tagline: Places and directions from the panel, no key needed
features: Type a place: Search, Directions from here, from home, from work, and the saved places that match; Enter opens it in Google Maps or Apple Maps
A route with both ends: `home > work`, `here -> Kadıköy`, `istanbul to ankara`; the reverse route as the second row
The travel mode is the filter: driving, transit, walking, cycling (Tab cycles it)
Nothing typed: Home, Work, the commute both ways and every saved place, each with Open, Directions, Copy address, Copy link and Open in the other app
With a Places API key, autocomplete predictions as you type, opened pinned to their place id
`go: coffee` or `maps: home > work` at the root answers inline

screenshots.caption: Nothing typed: Home, Work, the commute both ways and the saved places
kadıköy typed: Search, directions from here, home and work, a saved place that matches
home > work: the route and its reverse, walking chosen as the mode
With a Places API key: predictions under the rows
What a place can do: open, directions from here, from home, from work, copy the address or the link

actions.title: Open
actions.description: The place in the chosen app; on a route row, the directions.

actions.title: Directions from here
actions.description: From the current location to the place.

actions.title: Copy link
actions.description: The web url of what Enter would open.

actions.title: Open in the other app
actions.description: Apple Maps when Google is chosen, and the other way.

maps.description: Type a place or a route (`home > work`); the filter is the travel mode. Nothing typed lists home, work, the commute and the saved places. `maps:` or `go:` at the root answers inline.

keys.title: Open the place or the route
